*Bulbasaur* is a [Grass](/type/grass) / [Poison](/type/poison) type Pokémon introduced in Generation 1 .

*Bulbasaur* is a small, mainly turquoise amphibian Pokémon with red eyes and a green bulb on its back. It is based on a frog/toad, with the bulb resembling a plant bulb that grows into a flower as it evolves.

*Bulbasaur* is notable for being the very first Pokémon in the National Pokédex. It is one of the three choices for a starter Pokémon in the original Game Boy games, Pokémon Red &amp; Blue (Red &amp; Green in Japan), along with [Charmander](/pokedex/charmander) and [Squirtle](/pokedex/squirtle) .

- In Generation 1 , *Bulbasaur* has a base Special stat of 65.
- In Generations 2-7 , *Bulbasaur* has a base Friendship value of 70.
